task.question: In the Argentina vs Switzerland World Cup 2026 quarterfinal, who was sent off due to the mistaken identity protocol?
task.evidence: Leandro Paredes was shown a yellow card for a tackle on Breel Embolo –however, VAR revealed Embolo falling before Paredes made any contact. Since Embolo had already received a booking, he was sent off. It was the second time a yellow card had been overturned at the tournament due to the "mistaken identity" protocol.

answer: In the quarterfinal match between Argentina and Switzerland, Breel Embolo was sent off due to the mistaken identity protocol. FINAL: Breel Embolo
